sultanate-of-aceh uses the strings 'Aru' and 'Deli', not the slug kingdom-of-aru; the Aru region here is the same expression as Aceh's 1613 gain.

majapahit.json lacks vassal or gain events for Aru (1339-1365), Nan Sarunai (1354 vassal, 1362 gain; it names the slug nan-sarunai but has no vassal span) and Pagaruyung/Melayu (one string 'Sumatran principalities').

Disagreements between dossiers: Melayu independence 1028 (Melayu page) against srivijaya's 1202 loss of Jambi; Kedah 1026-1135 independent (Srivijaya page) against srivijaya and sultanate-of-kedah holding it; Langkasuka 1139-1224; Aceh gives the west Sumatran coast to the VOC in 1666 so Pagaruyung does not regain it.
sultanate-of-johor keeps mainland Riau to 1824, overlapping siak-sultanate from 1722; sultanate-of-malacca's counterpart 'Siak' is a pre-1722 string and is not siak-sultanate.
Ternate and Tidore discs overlap at grid resolution (shared Halmahera coast and strait islands).
WebFetch returns a summary, so quotes in the dossiers are the summariser's rendering, not byte copies.
Thirteen Wikipedia titles returned URL_NOT_FOUND (pages_failed); no Sumbawa page loaded.

Output exceeds the 6-10 target (20 dossiers); several are thin (3 events: sumedang-larang, kutai-martadipura, nan-sarunai, siak-sultanate, kertabhumi-majapahit) because the single page named no events in between.
